text:
zoe: Quick flag before KPI sync  weekly dashboard shows launch MQL spike but revenue and demos flat. link: https://app.redwood.com/dash/weekly-kpi
kyle: same. looks like a short-term email blast caused a weird bump.
hana: I see ~1.8k regs from last night but our ESP reports two send IDs for the same audience. possible duplicate sends -> duplicate registrations.
analytics-bot: [auto] Duplicate-event anomaly: registration events with matching email + different send_id detected (count=1748).
email-ops: confirmed: a retry job re-sent the launch nurture to a subset due to a timeout. investigating why retry didn't dedupe.
zoe: ok we shouldn't surface raw MQLs as success. propose: (1) mark the duplicate cohort and remove from headline MQL metric, (2) add "unique confirmed leads" to KPI slide, (3) pause any channel-scale calls until adjusted metrics land.
kyle: agree. also need a note in the bench narrative calling out the ESP retry bug and how we adjusted CAC math.
hana: pulling a de-duped CSV now and will upload to the dashboard team.
email-ops: adding dedupe at ingest and opening ticket #ESP-99 for retry logic fix. ETA EOD.
zoe: action items: hana upload de-duped numbers, email-ops fix retry/dedupe, analytics to publish adjusted KPI table. we'll table celebration until adjusted numbers are in the KPI deck.
analytics-bot: [reminder] Weekly KPI review in 20m  attach adjusted numbers to the deck.
